topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints significantly impact payload power allocation by limiting immediate service processing, increasing latency, and reducing payload efficiency. Time-tagged services require buffer space, impacting overall capacity. Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) can optimize power allocation by dynamically adjusting resources based on real-time storage constraints, prioritizing immediate services to prevent overflow while ensuring time-tagged services are stored efficiently. Machine Learning (ML) can predict future memory usage and adjust resource allocation proactively, further optimizing power allocation and resource utilization in satellite communication systems with limited on-board storage capacity.
